capabilities: Fetch page metadata automatically when links are pasted
Format links with custom templates using variables like {title} and {url}
Capture site-specific variables for YouTube, Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube Music, GitHub and images
Apply regex replacement rules to the formatted text
Blacklist domains and toggle automatic link formatting on or off
extras: Metadata for supported sites is fetched from those websites, so formatting depends on their availability.
problem: Pasting a URL into a note yields a bare link, and Obsidian has no built-in way to turn it into a titled, metadata-rich link automatically.
summary: Link formatter that fetches page metadata from pasted URLs and inserts configurable Markdown link templates.
